message.reasoning: We need to call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount equal to capacity minus current level. Capacity is 50 gallons. Current level is 10 liters. Need to convert 10 liters to gallons? Actually we know current level in liters. We need to fill to full capacity in gallons. But we need to know how many gallons to add. We could convert 10 liters to gallons: 10 liters * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So remaining capacity = 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. So we need to add about 47.36 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount ~47.36.
